Karl-Anthony Towns just added his name to a playoff stat line that almost feels unreal when you break it down.

In a game where the Knicks were fully in control, KAT quietly finished with a triple-double (12 points, 11 rebounds, 10 assists) while shooting just 1-4 from the field and 10-10 from the line.

He becomes the first player in NBA playoff history to record a triple-double with only 1 made field goal.

The previous playoff low for field goals in a triple-double was 2, held by legends like Draymond Green and Magic Johnson.

KAT also enters even rarer air, joining names like Isiah Thomas and Mark Eaton as the only players ever to post a triple-double with just one made shot.

A low-volume scoring night, but definitely one where KAT’s all-around game stood out in a big way.
